w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Redactor is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Chorus Line is here.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🪨 Peyton pries 3 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (77 stone now.)
💬 Ivy whispers: "Someone's been leaving food out, and Wren won't admit a thing. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/14/6), with 6 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 18 · Craft 4 · Talk 20 · Explore 44 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ASSIMILATED — "Remember the taste of grief."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
